sloka: वाक्यम् अप्रतिरूपम् तु न चित्रम् स्त्रीषु मैथिलि ।स्वभावः तु एष नारीणाम् एषु लोकेषु दृश्यते ॥३-४५-२९॥
transliteration: vākyam apratirūpam tu na citram strīṣu maithili ।svabhāvaḥ tu eṣa nārīṇām eṣu lokeṣu dṛśyate ॥3-45-29॥

translations.english: O princess from Mithila, I do not want to use such harsh words. To me you are a deity (worthy of adoration). It is not surprising that women of the world use such undeserving words. It is their nature.
